title: Scooter at the Park
can_do: 听懂一个明天的家庭安排，并贡献一个可执行的选择和准备步骤。

conversation_move.label: contribute one idea to a plan

trigger: Mom shares tomorrow's park plan, and the child wants to bring a scooter that requires a helmet.
core_response: I want to ride my scooter there.
stretch_response: First my helmet, then my scooter. Can we pack them tonight?
repair_response: I mean the scooter, with my helmet.
setting: Making a simple family plan at home.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Tomorrow we are going to the park after breakfast.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I want to ride my scooter there.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: We can take it if we remember your helmet.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: First my helmet, then my scooter. Can we pack them tonight?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Yes. Put them by the door, and we will be ready.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Okay. I will get my helmet first.

replay_cards.title: Library tomorrow
replay_cards.change: The child wants to return one book and choose another
replay_cards.challenge: Add that idea to Mom's plan, name the book to pack, and place it by the bag

replay_cards.title: Picnic tomorrow
replay_cards.change: Dad offers fruit or crackers to bring
replay_cards.challenge: Choose one, suggest packing it after breakfast, and add it to the family list

parent_support: Begin with one real family plan and invite one manageable contribution.
Connect the child's idea to a necessary preparation without turning planning into a lecture.
